allowedScope: Repair, harden, or expose a protocol, parser, terminal-model, or resource-accounting feature already present at the exact upstream pin.

Add only the private evidence adapter, immutable consumer-snapshot boundary, exact ABI identity, reproducible build integration, typed admission accounting, and teardown proof required by the frozen gates.

The common RedSalamander-owned Terminal plugin, renderer, HWND, ConPTY, pane, tab, accessibility, settings, and shell-policy integration is outside the engine nomination and is not a subsystem the candidate must provide.
forbiddenScope: Add a protocol family absent at the exact upstream pin.
Add a second authoritative parser or terminal model.
Add or retain a candidate-owned renderer, window, control, event loop, or UI runtime.
Add a non-system runtime leaf or binary patch.
Use generated-file exclusions, rename detection, future upstream work, volunteer time, or another candidate's implementation to reduce measured adaptation cost.

ownerDayMethod.estimateRule: Use a reviewer-approved upper-bound estimate that includes x64 and ARM64 build, tests, packaging, upgrade, security, notice, and rollback maintenance.
ownerDayMethod.newToolchainDefinition: A compiler or language tool family not already required by the RedSalamander product build and CI at the frozen baseline.
ownerDayMethod.runtimeLeafEvidenceRule: Count the recursively resolved non-system PE/load closure from the clean portable package; a source-static dependency is not a runtime leaf.

patchMetricAlgorithm.binaryRule: Any binary numstat '-' field or GIT binary patch rejects the nomination.
patchMetricAlgorithm.concernMappingRule: Every changed path maps to at least one closed-taxonomy concern; the unique concern count is cap-enforced and two reviewers approve the complete mapping.
patchMetricAlgorithm.fileCountRule: Count every touched source, build, test, documentation, generated-glue, and adapter path record from git diff --no-renames --name-status; rename detection is disabled so a move counts as delete plus add.
patchMetricAlgorithm.lineCountRule: Sum additions plus deletions from git diff --no-renames --numstat over every changed source, build, test, documentation, generated-glue, and adapter file; no exclusion.
patchMetricAlgorithm.resultTreeRule: Apply the exact raw patch to the exact upstream tree with core.autocrlf=false and require the resulting git write-tree identity to equal resultTree.
